snippet.title: Fate/Grand Order - Fourth Singularity: The Mist City, London - Available Now
snippet.description:
From the official Fate mobile RPG, Fate/Grand Order:

🇬🇧 Fourth Singularity: The Mist City, London 🇬🇧

The battle surrounding the Holy Grail has no moved to a city covered in a mysterious fog, London.

The newest chapter in Fate/Grand Order, London, is available now! 

The fourth Grand Order is set in 1888. The Great British Empire in the Industrial Revolution Age where civilization flourished. This new fierce battle shall commence around the fourth Holy Grail, in this city isolated by a demonic fog.

Download Fate/Grand Order for free and join the battle today!
For more information, visit fate-go.us/event/
